body: ## What and why On 32-row prefill tiles the shared expert runs as tiles of the routed expert passes, so its gate, up and down wait for the router, the route select, the grouping and the gather, though they read only the layer's rows. This PR runs the shared expert of those plans as dense GGUF prefill projections (the kernels `Linear::addGgufPrefill` uses), each encoded ahead of the routing dispatch it overlaps (router, gather, first gate/up pass) on a concurrent compute encoder. To allow that, `CommandGraph` can mark a dispatch concurrent with the ones before it; a command with such a dispatch puts a buffer barrier before every unmarked one, and commands without one encode as before. Separately, `moe_gather_rows` and `moe_combine` move four columns per thread, and the gather copies a tile's live rows only. 8-row plans, decode included, are unchanged. Three commits: the dispatch flag (backend only), the gather/combine change, and the shared expert beside the routing. ## Numbers M5 Pro, AC power, no thermal or performance warnings, 90% memory free, no swap-outs during the runs; GPU clock (powermetrics, 500 ms samples in the first A and B slot) 1616-1620 MHz while prefilling, 1527-1620 MHz while decoding. Served through `server.server` with `--max-cache-disk 0`, base `be3b083` vs this branch, weights preloaded into the page cache before each server start, one server start per slot, ABBA order. Prefill: cold prompts of about N tokens, `max_tokens` 1, GPU tok/s from `/status` prefill `total_gpu_ms` deltas, 3 timed prompts per size per slot after warm-up. Mean over rounds +- 95% CI (t); B/A is the per-round paired ratio; A/A is slot 4 A over slot 1 A. IQ3_S MoE GGUF target, 5 ABBA rounds: | prefill, GPU tok/s | base | branch | B/A paired | A/A null | |---|---:|---:|---:|---:| | 512 tokens | 2527 +- 41 | 2589 +- 45 | 1.0245 +- 0.0085 | +0.03 +- 1.18% | | 2048 tokens | 2810 +- 165 | 2884 +- 172 | 1.0264 +- 0.0065 | -1.38 +- 3.92% | Q4_K_M MoE GGUF target (same architecture), 5 ABBA rounds: | prefill, GPU tok/s | base | branch | B/A paired | A/A null | |---|---:|---:|---:|---:| | 512 tokens | 2553 +- 20 | 2623 +- 31 | 1.0271 +- 0.0048 | -0.31 +- 0.75% | | 2048 tokens | 2905 +- 149 | 2985 +- 163 | 1.0276 +- 0.0054 | -0.97 +- 1.85% | Decode is unchanged. IQ3_S target with its DFlash draft, 24 prompts x 256 greedy tokens per slot, 3 ABBA rounds: | decode | base | branch | B/A paired | A/A null | |---|---:|---:|---:|---:| | tok/s (tau 4.220 both) | 174.1 +- 3.6 | 174.4 +- 1.4 | 1.0014 +- 0.0131 | +1.06 +- 4.30% | | GPU ms per cycle | 24.43 +- 0.59 | 24.39 +- 0.24 | 0.9984 +- 0.0142 | -1.16 +- 4.62% | ## Correctness - The dense projections run another tile and K step than the shared tiles, so prefill on 32-row tiles is not guaranteed to be bit-identical to `be3b083`. A row's result is still the same in every chunk size (gguf-moe's 263/33/16 and 256/48/12/1 chunk checks) and within the same bounds of the fp64 reference. - In the served runs, greedy outputs matched the base's exactly: 288 of 288 decode prompt runs (24 prompts x 12 slots), and 8 of 8 long prompts (about 850 and 3400 tokens, 48 greedy tokens each, in A B B A). - The combine keeps each element's sum in route order. The gather leaves the padding rows a tile's matmul reads as they were instead of zeroing them; a matmul's rows are independent and those rows' outputs are never read. - gguf-moe: the shared routes map to the shared rows, the shared intermediate is checked in its own scratch, and the full-grid, two-pass reference no longer runs the up pass concurrently with the gate pass it reads. MoeExtents and operator-workspace cover the new scratch field and the input extent. - Run on an M5 Pro, all passing: `make check-source check-native-cpu`, `make check-native-metal` (shader validation), `make check-native-build`, `make test-sanitizers`. The middle commit alone builds and passes gguf-moe and operator-workspace; the first builds. The real-model release check was not run. ## Caveats - Measured on one machine (M5 Pro) and one MoE architecture; other GPU families were not measured. - `MoeGroupParams` grows from 28 to 32 bytes (`shared_base`). A 32-row prefill plan's input must hold its rows rounded up to 32 (`MoePlan::inputRows`); the production prefill input holds the full 2048-row budget. - The separate gate pass overlaps the shared down pass only while the expert intermediate is no wider than the hidden size, as the parked gate and the shared rows of `expertOutput` are then disjoint. - Additive to #345, #346 and #365, which this builds on and does not change: 8-row and in-place plans take the same path as before. #367 (live-row decode expert passes on Apple9) touches a different part of the MoE path. 🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code) https://claude.ai/code/session_012gTpeJqYXcXA8LvLavka8w --- Need help on this PR?
